leadText:
Camp Pokéhearst is an -exclusive location in the Kanto region that appeared in Go West Young Meowth. It is located east of Hollywood. It was unnamed in the Japanese version.

There is a baseball pitch where the campers practice. The campsite has a projector and large sheet, allowing them to show outdoor movies to the campers.
 
 's earliest memory is waking up alone in the rain in a basket here. He was all alone, and was so hungry that he tried to eat a basket of baseballs. He ended up just knocking it over, causing the baseball coach to string him up from a tree as punishment. From this position, that evening he was able to watch the movie , which was being shown as a special treat for the campers, direct from Hollywood. He then grabbed onto the next truck heading towards Hollywood.
